      • setCursor

        void setCursor(String fieldName)
        Sets the screen cursor.
        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are e.g.
        • german: 
          .CURSOR 'fieldName'
        • english: 
          .CURSOR 'fieldName'

        Parameters:
        fieldName - The field to position on.

      • setCursor

        void setCursor(String fieldName,
               int row)
        Sets the screen cursor.
        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are e.g.
        • german: 
          .CURSOR 'fieldName' 'row'
        • english: 
          .CURSOR 'fieldName' 'row'

        Parameters:
        fieldName - The field to position on.
        row - The row containing the field (0 means header).

      • setProtection

        void setProtection(boolean enabled,
                   ScreenBuffer.ProtectionScope scope,
                   String itemName,
                   ScreenBuffer.ProtectionType type,
                   int row)
        Universal protection method.
        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are e.g.
        • german: 
          .SCHUTZ -'scope' 'itemName' 'row' -'type' [-RESET]
        • english: 
          .PROTECTION -'scope' 'itemName' 'row' -'type' [-RESET]

        Parameters:
        enabled - True if the protection flag should be enabled.
        scope - The protection scope.
        itemName - The item name (may be null if the scope is ScreenBuffer.ProtectionScope.ALL, ScreenBuffer.ProtectionScope.TABLE or ScreenBuffer.ProtectionScope.LINE.
        type - The protection action.
        row - The row.

      • setProtectionException

        void setProtectionException(boolean enabled,
                            ScreenBuffer.ProtectionScope scope,
                            String itemName,
                            ScreenBuffer.ProtectionType type,
                            int row)
        Universal protection method. This methods sets exceptions for protection calls. If an exception for a protection type is set the protection type will be ignored and the field is unprotected.
        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are e.g.
        • german: 
          .SCHUTZ -'scope' 'itemName' 'row' -'type' -AUSNAHME [-RESET]
        • english: 
          .PROTECTION -'scope' 'itemName' 'row' -'type' -EXCEPTION [-RESET]

        Parameters:
        enabled - True if the protection flag should be enabled.
        scope - The protection scope.
        itemName - The item name (may be null if the scope is ScreenBuffer.ProtectionScope.ALL, ScreenBuffer.ProtectionScope.TABLE or ScreenBuffer.ProtectionScope.LINE.
        type - The protection action.
        row - The row.

      • setWriteProtection

        void setWriteProtection(boolean enabled,
                        String field)
        Sets the write protection flag on a head field.

        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are e.g.
        • german: 
          .SCHUTZ -FELD 'field' 0 -GESCHUETZT [-RESET]
        • english: 
          .PROTECTION -FIELD 'field' 0 -PROTECTED [-RESET]

        Parameters:
        enabled - if true write protection will be enabled - disabled otherwise.
        field - the field name.
